decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor for powerful creatures and disrupt opponents' strategies. By utilizing a high creature count and a variety of lands to support Enigmatic Incarnation, the deck aims to control the board and overwhelm opponents with value creatures. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds extra value and flexibility to the deck, allowing for more powerful plays and increased consistency in longer games. With a strong mana base and a mix of disruptive spells, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the pieces needed to create a powerful combo involving Greasefang and Parhelion II. The key idea is to use cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Blackcleave Cliffs to ramp up quickly towards the combo pieces, while using removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board and protect the combo. The deck also includes additional threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Overlord of the Balemurk to apply pressure and take advantage of the opponent's resources.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice synergies with Witch's Oven, Cauldron Familiar, and Mayhem Devil to deal incremental damage to the opponent while generating value. The deck also includes disruption with Claim the Firstborn and removal spells like Fatal Push to control the board. Scavenger's Talent is used to generate additional resources while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Bloodtithe Harvester provide additional aggression. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature pressure, sacrifice effects, and removal spells.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful multicolored spells and versatile removal options. By utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn's ability to draw multiple cards and provide card advantage, the deck can outvalue opponents in long games. The inclusion of various triomes and mana fixing cards allows for consistent casting of spells with multiple colored mana requirements. With Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion, the deck can also generate additional value and card advantage by blinking permanents. Overall, the deck aims to control the battlefield and grind out wins through card advantage and synergy.

The main strategy of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to play aggressively and quickly overwhelm the opponent with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero, backed up by spells like Infuriate and Reckless Rage to deal damage and clear blockers. The deck also utilizes powerful lands like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins to generate additional threats. The inclusion of cards like Claim / Fame allows for additional flexibility and recursion, while cards like Fatal Push provide removal options. Overall, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain dominance throughout the game.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay, utilizing low-cost creatures and spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. With cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced offense. Spells like Reckless Rage and Infuriate help give an edge in combat, while cards like Kumano Faces Kakkazan provide additional pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes a mix of lands like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins for additional versatility and reach. Overall, the deck aims to quickly close out games through aggressive tactics.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays, utilizing a mix of creatures and spells to apply pressure to the opponent. With a blend of removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, along with powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while hitting hard and fast. The deck also includes mana-fixing lands like Blightstep Pathway and dual lands like Blood Crypt to ensure consistency in casting its spells. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its efficient and aggressive gameplay.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays using Rakdos-themed cards to quickly overwhelm the opponent and maintain board advantage. It includes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying powerful creatures such as Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to apply pressure. The deck aims to control the game tempo through a combination of aggro creatures, disruption spells, and mana efficiency, ultimately leading to a fast and decisive victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a Selesnya color combination, utilizing creatures such as Archon of Emeria, Aven Interrupter, and Skyclave Apparition to put pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben to slow down the opponent's game plan. Collected Company is used to find additional creatures and Boseiju, Who Endures provides protection for key spells. Overall, the deck aims to quickly build a board presence and overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own strategy.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with efficient and aggressive creatures and powerful removal spells. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Duress and Thoughtseize while applying pressure with creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck also includes burn spells like Torch the Tower and Fatal Push to maintain board control. The versatile land base allows for flexibility in mana production, ensuring that the deck can consistently keep up the pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive spirit creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer, Spell Queller, and Supreme Phantom to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The spirits benefit from various buffs and protection spells while disrupting opponent's plans with counterspells and exile effects. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while maintaining control of the battlefield, eventually securing victory through a combination of efficient creatures and smart spell choices. It is a fast-paced and versatile strategy that can adapt to different matchups in the Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with strong creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overpower opponents. The key strategy is to apply pressure early with creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Mutavault while using removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to control the board. The deck also includes powerful discard spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the goal is to maintain a fast-paced, aggressive playstyle to dominate the game and secure a quick victory.

This Dimir Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Spell Pierce while maintaining a steady stream of aggressive creatures like Spyglass Siren and Floodpits Drowner. The deck also includes cards that provide additional value, such as Unholy Annex and Moon-Circuit Hacker. With a mix of disruption and aggression, the deck aims to control the early game and put pressure on the opponent to close out the game quickly.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence and dealing damage to the opponent as efficiently as possible. The key strategy involves playing aggressive creatures like Bloodletter of Aclazotz and Gray Merchant of Asphodel to drain the opponent's life total. Utilizing cards like Liliana of the Veil and Fiend Artisan to control the board while setting up powerful swings with cards like The Meathook Massacre and Agadeem's Awakening. The deck also includes various ways to generate additional mana in order to cast multiple spells in a turn and overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of threats.

The key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using efficient creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Archon of Emeria, Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, and Skyclave Apparition to control the game and applying pressure with cards like Aven Interrupter and Knight of Autumn, the deck aims to quickly establish a dominant board presence and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. Additionally, the inclusion of Collected Company allows for explosive turns and helps maintain card advantage throughout the game.

The key strategy of this deck is to quickly flood the board with Human creatures that grow in power when they enter the battlefield, such as Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disrupt their plays with cards like Reflector Mage. The inclusion of protection spells like Get Lost and Dauntless Bodyguard helps to keep key creatures safe. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the aggressive game plan and ensure consistent casting of spells.
